data.summary: October 2046 in Marbella offers warm seas, calm winds, and fewer crowds — ideal for a shoulder-season yacht charter. This guide covers weather stats, what to pack, and which boats to book from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: Is October 2046 a good time for a yacht charter in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes. October offers warm sea temperatures around 20°C, mild air temperatures of 18–25°C, and fewer crowds than summer. The Levante wind is lighter, and you'll often have calm mornings. It's a shoulder-season sweet spot for a relaxed, more affordable charter.

faq.q: What should I wear for a yacht charter in October 2046?
faq.a: Bring layers: a light jumper or windbreaker for the morning, a swimsuit for midday, and sun protection (hat, sunglasses, SPF 30+). Evenings cool down to about 15°C, so a light jacket is essential. Non-slip shoes are recommended on deck.

faq.q: Will the sea be rough in October 2046?
faq.a: Generally no. The Western Mediterranean in October sees swells of 0.5–1.5 metres, with occasional Levante days. Your skipper will monitor forecasts and can adjust the itinerary to sheltered spots like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés if needed. Morning departures often have the calmest conditions.

faq.q: Can I swim and snorkel in October 2046?
faq.a: Yes. Sea temperature around 20°C is brisk but refreshing, especially in the afternoon sun. Many guests enjoy a quick dip. If you're sensitive to cooler water, a wetsuit top is a good idea. Your crew can suggest the best snorkelling spots near Cabopino or the Marbella coastline.

faq.q: What are the daylight hours in October 2046?
faq.a: Sunrise is around 08:30 and sunset around 19:30, giving you roughly 11 hours of daylight. For a full-day charter, you'll have plenty of time to cruise to Estepona or Sotogrande and back. An 8-hour charter from 10:00 to 18:00 is ideal.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book a yacht for October 2046?
faq.a: October is shoulder season, so availability is better than summer, but popular boats like the Mangusta 80 or Ferretti 94 still get booked. We recommend reserving 2–4 weeks ahead. For weekends, book at least a month in advance to secure your preferred vessel.

faq.q: What is the weather like in Marbella in early vs late October 2046?
faq.a: Early October typically has warmer air (up to 25°C) and sea temps around 21°C. Late October cools slightly to 18–22°C air and 19–20°C sea. Rainfall is slightly higher in late October, but showers are usually brief. Both periods are fine for chartering.

data.body_html:
October 2046 in Marbella is the shoulder season that savvy charterers love. The summer crowds have gone, the sea is still warm at around 20°C, and the air hovers between 18°C and 25°C. You get the same stunning coastline — from Puerto Banús to Cabopino, Estepona and Sotogrande — with more space, lighter winds and a more relaxed pace. Here's everything you need to know about the weather and how to make the most of a yacht charter in October 2046.

October 2046 Weather Overview for Marbella

October in Marbella is typically mild and sunny, with occasional short showers. Expect average highs of 24°C and lows of 15°C. Sea temperature sits at a comfortable 20°C — perfect for a refreshing swim. Rainfall averages 40mm across 5–6 days, usually in brief downpours rather than all-day rain. Winds are generally light, 10–15 knots, with the Levante (easterly) occasionally picking up to 20 knots in the afternoon.

Sea Conditions and Wave Height

The Western Mediterranean in October is usually calm. Swell heights range from 0.5 to 1.5 metres, with the calmest conditions in the morning. By midday, a gentle chop may develop, but it rarely affects comfort on a 12-metre or larger yacht. For the smoothest ride, choose a morning departure and head east towards Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, where the coastline offers shelter.

Best Times of Day for Chartering

October daylight runs from roughly 08:30 to 19:30. The best window for boating is 11:00 to 17:00, when the sun is highest and the sea is at its warmest. Early mornings are cooler but glassy — ideal for photography or a peaceful breakfast at anchor. Evenings cool down quickly, so plan to be back in port by 18:00 to enjoy a sunset from the marina.

What to Pack for an October Charter

  • Light layers: a cotton shirt, a fleece or light jumper, and a windbreaker.
  • Swimsuit and a quick-dry towel for swimming stops.
  • Sun protection: SPF 30+ sunscreen, sunglasses, and a wide-brimmed hat.
  • Non-slip deck shoes or boat shoes.
  • A light jacket for the evening — temperatures drop to 15°C.
  • If you're prone to seasickness, bring motion sickness tablets just in case.

Which Boats Are Best for October Weather?

For a small group, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are excellent choices — both depart from Puerto Banús and include skipper, drinks, snacks, and insurance. For a larger party or more space, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) offers a flybridge and a free jet ski, with a 4-hour minimum. Other options like the Ferretti 94 (29m) or Canados 86 (26m) provide extra luxury. All our boats are fully equipped for cooler days, with indoor saloons and heating if needed.

Where to Cruise in October

October is perfect for a relaxed cruise along the Costa del Sol. Head west towards Estepona — about 20 nautical miles from Puerto Banús — or east to Cabopino and Cala del Faro. You can anchor in a quiet cove, swim, and enjoy a picnic lunch. For a longer trip, Sotogrande is a 30-nautical-mile run, but with calm seas it's very doable in a day. Your skipper will tailor the route to the day's weather.

October 2046 Pricing and Availability

Shoulder season means better availability and often more flexible booking. Our Tier A boats — the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 — are priced at €749 for 2 hours and €2,299 for 8 hours, all inclusive. The Mangusta 80 (white or grey) starts at €4,719 for a 4-hour charter, with a free jet ski. For other vessels, pricing is on request via WhatsApp — just ask and we'll confirm availability for your dates.

Why Choose Shoulder Season?

October 2046 gives you the best of both worlds: summer-like sea temperatures but autumn's calm and quiet. Marinas like Puerto Banús and Marbella Marina are less crowded, restaurants are easier to book, and the golden light over La Concha is stunning. It's also a budget-friendly time — you'll find better rates than July or August. If you're flexible with dates, this is the smartest time to charter.
